/: Tufanganj Vivekananda Vidyalaya (H.S.) is a higher secondary school in Tufanganj, Cooch Behar, West Bengal, teaching since 1964. It offers Class V to XII, with Science and Arts streams in Class XI and XII. This website has the school's notices, admission enquiry form, faculty, achievements and results, campus information, events, gallery and the student and staff portal.
